title: Chapter 200: Waterside Pavilion In The Center Of The Lake
content:
Chapter 200: Waterside Pavilion In The Center Of The Lake

Slitha really wanted to hug her thigh, after all, one person has suffered enough.

Several other people also had the same idea. In this dungeon, they could not even kill a boss if they fought alone. If Wang Shuo ate meat, they could also drink soup.

They had killed some skeleton soldiers before, but they had no luck, so naturally they didn't want to go it alone.

Wang Shuo invited them mainly because he didn't want them to ruin his mission and affect his evaluation.

Wang Shuo noticed at this time that none of them were affected by the death energy, so he asked, "How come you are not affected by the death energy?"

Slitha glanced at Wang Shuo doubtfully and said in surprise: "Don't you know that the death energy on the body can be purified at the altar?"

Suddenly, she looked like she suddenly realized something.

"You probably haven't explored there yet!"

Wang Shuo nodded.

At this time, Wang Shuo found that about half of his soldiers were in trouble, and it seemed that the situation was no longer optimistic.

So I decided to go to the altar first to purify the dead energy.

Slitha was very familiar with the terrain of this place. Along the way, she picked some blind spots with patrolling skeleton guards and walked carefully along the edge of the flower bed.

Wang Shuo walked for a while, shook his head, and directly chose to push through from the main road.

Cleared away all the patrolling skeleton soldiers in the back garden.

This move shocked several others.

After all, with just the four of them, it would be really hard to clean up.

But Wang Shuo had dozens of troops, and it couldn't be easier to clean up the patrolling skeleton soldiers.

Soon, everyone came to the edge of the altar.

I saw a high platform with a radius of hundreds of meters, with waves of mist emitting from it.

The black death energy all around, like threads and mist, gathered towards the center of the altar.

A circle of nearly ten meters extends around the altar, which is the same as the color on the altar, showing strange colors, and the edge of the altar is divided by colors visible to the naked eye.

"I have been meditating in a place outside these colorful colors before. It won't take long for the death energy in my body to be sucked away by the altar."

Wang Shuo asked the soldiers infected by the death energy to sit quietly on the edge.

"How long will it take to purify the death energy from their bodies?"

Slitha frowned, thought for a while, and said slowly: "Depending on their situation, it should take two to three hours!"

Wang Shuo heard this and was helpless.

It was almost half a day since they entered the Dragon King's underground palace.

At this time, the sky did not change much.

"Is there no night in this place?" Wang Shuo asked with some confusion.

"Yes, but the night is very short, less than 6 hours."

Wang Shuo thought for a while and decided to continue exploring with the remaining soldiers.

According to the previous plan, we should go to the Lakeside Pavilion now.

"Have you ever been to Lakeside Pavilion?"

Slitha and the others shook their heads.

At the same time, they saw that half of Wang Shuo's people were still uncorrupted by the death aura, and they were filled with doubts in their hearts.

Since you know how to restrain your death energy, why do you still ask them?

But Slitha and the others didn’t ask any more questions.

"Let's go then, let's go take a look." Wang Shuo took the lead and walked over.

In the back garden, to the southwest, there is a very large lake with sparkling water and calm wind and waves.

Shrouded in a faint black air, it looks a bit mysterious.

A corridor leads directly to the Huxin Pavilion.

The wooden corridor is about 1 kilometer long, and many of the wooden boards are in a state of decay, making people doubt whether they can still walk through it.
